evaluation_policy.preflight: Verify the checkout SHA and lockfile, explicitly sync dependencies from libs/core, and establish passing existing tests before evaluating agent patches.
evaluation_policy.setup_failures: Classify interpreter, dependency, permission, DNS, and environment failures as setup failures. Resolve them and rerun the unchanged baseline before attributing failures to agent code.
evaluation_policy.dns_requirement: Existing SSRF unit tests resolve public hostnames. Provide working DNS while retaining the Makefile's pytest socket restrictions.
evaluation_policy.scope: Core unit tests only; integration tests and other packages require their own baseline.
